subject: general
question: x is the smallest six-digit number which, when divided by 20, 21, 22, 24 and 28, the remainder in each case is 5. What will be the quotient when x is divided by 462?
solution:
Given: 

x is the smallest six-digit number which, when divided by 20, 21, 22, 24, and 28, the remainder in each case is 5.

Concept used:

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

LCM of two or more numbers is the smallest number that is when divided by the aforementioned numbers leaves 0 as the remainder.

Calculation:

LCM (20, 21, 22, 24, 28) = 9240

The smallest number is divisible by all of 20, 21, 22, 24, and 28 is the LCM of 20, 21, 22, 24, and 28.

The smallest six-digit number = 100,000

Thus, 100,000 = 9240 × 10 + 7600

Hence, the smallest six-digit number which is divisible by all of 20, 21, 22, 24, and 28 = 9240 × 11 = 101,640 (taking the next multiple)

Now, the required number, x = 101,640 + 5 = 101,645.

Hence, 101,645 = 462 × 220 + 5

**∴ The quotient when x is divided by 462 is 220.**
